0d_identity (s2_verify0d).note: mismatch_deg3 = 0: Delta_K W_0|_3 = (1/2)str[KSH3PSH3PSH3] + (1/2)(str[KSH3PSH4]+str[KSH4PSH3]) + C_P((1/2)str[KSH3PSH3], I_3) (I-a + I-d); the deg-2 d_P((1/2){I,I}_K) comparison differs only by P-tadpoles when d_P I_3 != 0 (absent in the field theory, tr ad = 0) and matches for P-tadpole-free I_3 (seeds 4, 5); the wrong sign of I-a fails (control).

method_notes: D_0 part of Q W at order hbar = hbar Delta_{K'} W_0 + {W_0, W_1}_{K'} (exact identity, s2_notes.txt S1); I-a = 1PI part = hbar (1/2) str[K' S H (P S H)^{n-1}], validated as a polynomial identity in a 0-dim super model (s2_verify0d.py) and by the exact reproduction of the Step-1 two-leg special bubbles (s2_regress2pt.py).

Each oriented graph: numerator N(k) reconstructed exactly as a polynomial (Newton forward differences on the simplex lattice, checked at extra points), Gaussian loop integral with moments (Delta^j N)(-K(u))/(4^j j! T^j), Schwinger variables scaled by eps (special tau_1 in [0,1], others in [1,infty)); eps^e coefficient = sum_{j-i=n-2-e} (4^j j! i!)^{-1} int T^{-2-j+i} F_j (-q)^i.
Convergence: integrand <= C T^{-2-j+i}, large-tau region of dimension n-1, T >= n-1 >= 1; converges iff j - i > n - 3, i.e. e < 1. Remainder O(eps log eps); no log eps term in any I-a graph.
Exact integrals J(n;beta;N) in Q + Q log2 + Q log3 (sympy iterated rational integration), each confirmed by an independent evaluation in (T,u) variables at 50 digits and PSLQ on {1, log2, log3}.

Projection: each class fitted exactly (sympy over Q(i)) on a complete basis of Spin(4) x Spin(6) x colour-f invariant forms of the legs (parity-odd and chirality-weighted ones included) with extra samples; full column rank checked; then expressed in G1..G5 with zero residual.

Colour: every I-a colour factor is a cyclic contraction of three structure constants with (-,-)^{-1}: tr_g(ad_X ad_Y ad_Z) = (1/2) tr_g(ad_{[X,Y]} ad_Z) = (1/2) [tr_g(ad ad)/(-,-)] ([X,Y],Z) for every simple g (ad_X antisymmetric for (-,-)); confirmed: identical per-class coefficients for su(2) (orthonormal) and sl(3) = complexified su(3) (embedded in gl(3) with the unimodular trace form; the centre has zero brackets and decouples), fits with the f-structure only and zero residual.

Tree-level pieces (II-a, III, I-b, I-d, II-b) evaluated exactly in a plane-wave mode model with the BV bracket, Q as the derivation {S_free,-}, kernels Khat and Pnum (tests: Q^2 = 0, Q Pnum = |p|^2 Khat, derivation = bracket, mode-model vertices = canonical vertex functions, G_i formulas).

Independent internal check: in all four sectors the full regulated sum (I-a at finite eps without expansion, I-b + III(K') with the finite-eps self-energies, I-d + II-b with the finite-eps special bubbles; II-a + III(K_0) = 0 exactly) at eps = 1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-6 and generic momenta approaches alpha.G + tree(Ob_2, I_3) like eps log eps.
No dimensional regularisation; no IR scale; Euclidean; upper Schwinger limit infinity.
